cd /app/work && python3 << 'EOF'
import json, re, glob
data = json.load(open('fpbase_all.json'))

def pdb_seqs():
    d = {}
    for f in glob.glob('fasta_*.fa'):
        pid = f.replace('fasta_','').replace('.fa','')
        for line in open(f):
            if line.startswith('>'): continue
            s = line.strip()
            if s: d[pid] = s
    return d

pdb = pdb_seqs()
for pid in sorted(pdb):
    seq = pdb[pid]
    pat = re.escape(seq).replace('X', '.{1,3}')
    rx = re.compile(pat)
    best = []
    for p in data:
        s = p.get('seq','')
        if not s: continue
        if rx.search(s):
            states = [(st['name'], st.get('ex_max'), st.get('em_max')) for st in p.get('states',[])]
            best.append((p['name'], states))
    print(pid, '->', best if best else 'NO MATCH')
EOF

cd /app/work && python3 << 'EOF'
import json, glob, difflib
data = json.load(open('fpbase_all.json'))

def pdb_seqs():
    d = {}
    for f in glob.glob('fasta_*.fa'):
        pid = f.replace('fasta_','').replace('.fa','')
        for line in open(f):
            if line.startswith('>'): continue
            s = line.strip()
            if s: d[pid] = s
    return d

pdb = pdb_seqs()
sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher()
for pid in sorted(pdb):
    seq = pdb[pid]
    best = []
    for p in data:
        s = p.get('seq','')
        if not s or len(s) < 100: continue
        sm.set_seq1(seq); sm.set_seq2(s)
        blocks = sm.get_matching_blocks()
        total = sum(b.size for b in blocks)
        # require long contiguous match
        mx = max((b.size for b in blocks), default=0)
        if mx >= 150:
            states = [(st['name'], st.get('ex_max'), st.get('em_max')) for st in p.get('states',[])]
            best.append((mx, total, p['name'], states))
    best.sort(reverse=True)
    print(pid, '->', best[:3] if best else 'NO MATCH')
EOF

import urllib.request, re, os
ids = [l.strip() for l in open('/app/pdb_ids.txt') if l.strip()]
for i in ids:
    fn = f'cif_{i}.cif'
    if not os.path.exists(fn):
        url = f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{i}.cif'
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        data = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120).read().decode()
        open(fn,'w').write(data)
    # extract nonpolymer components
    txt = open(fn).read()
    m = re.findall(r'_pdbx_entity_nonpoly\.(?:id|comp_id)\s+(\S+)', txt)
    # pair them
    comps = []
    in_cat = False
    for line in txt.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('_pdbx_entity_nonpoly.'):
            in_cat = True
            continue
        if in_cat:
            if line.startswith('_') or line.startswith('#'):
                in_cat = False
            elif line.strip():
                parts = line.split()
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    comps.append((parts[0], parts[1]))
    print(i, '->', comps)
EOF

            sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, pdb5y, s)
            mx = max((b.size for b in sm.get_matching_blocks()), default=0)
            ratio = sm.ratio()
            states=[(st['name'],st.get('ex_max'),st.get('em_max')) for st in p.get('states',[])]
            print(f"{name}: maxlen_match={mx} ratio={ratio:.3f} states={states}")
            # show diffs
            for tag,i1,i2,j1,j2 in sm.get_opcodes():
                if tag!='equal':
                    print('   ',tag, repr(pdb5y[i1:i2]), '||', repr(s[j1:j2]))
            break
